description: Figure 2, titled "Training Loss of 20M Data Size," is a line plot that illustrates the training loss for various models over the course of training, measured in steps. The x-axis represents the number of training steps, ranging from 0K to 440K, with major tick marks at intervals of 20K. The y-axis represents the training loss, with values ranging from 0.0 to 0.85. The plot displays six distinct lines, each corresponding to a different model configuration as indicated in the legend: ChemBART Small 20M (red), ChemBART Medium 20M (blue), ChemBERTa Small 20M (green), ChemBERTa Medium 20M (orange), ChemLLaMA Small 20M (purple), and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M (brown). All six lines exhibit a similar trend: they start at a high training loss value (approximately 0.8) and rapidly decrease within the first 20K steps. After this initial drop, the loss values for all models stabilize and remain relatively flat, hovering around a value of 0.1. The lines for the smaller models (ChemBART Small 20M, ChemBERTa Small 20M, ChemLLaMA Small 20M) are generally positioned slightly higher than the lines for the medium-sized models (ChemBART Medium 20M, ChemBERTa Medium 20M, ChemLLaMA Medium 20M), indicating a consistently lower training loss for the medium-sized models across the entire training process.
